2607.15190.title: Can We Trust Item Response Theory for AI Evaluation?
2607.15190.paper_summary: AI benchmarks increasingly leverage item-level statistical models, particularly item response theory (IRT), to estimate model capabilities, rank systems, select informative examples, and diagnose benchmark quality. However, AI benchmark data often departs from the data regime of human testing, for which standard IRT estimation tools were originally developed: benchmarks typically involve fewer evaluated models, far more items, and capability distributions that may be skewed, clustered, or multimodal. We examine how these regime mismatches challenge the reliability of IRT modeling for AI evaluation. Using item parameters and capability distributions derived from six widely used LLM benchmarks, we simulate response matrices under three common IRT models and compare four estimation tools used in recent benchmark studies: marginal maximum likelihood, Markov chain Monte Carlo, variational inference, and a neural pseudo-Siamese estimator. Across 18,000 simulation conditions, we systematically evaluate computational feasibility, scalability, and the reliability of IRT inferences about model rankings, predicted performance, and item characteristics. Results show that classical estimators can become infeasible in large benchmark settings, whereas scalable estimators can produce unreliable item-level and ranking inferences with small or nonnormally distributed model sets. This study identifies when latent trait models reliably support or risk distorting AI benchmarking claims, and what sample sizes and diagnostics are needed for trustworthy use.
2607.15190.paper_summary_zh: AI 基準越來越多地利用項目級統計模型，特別是項目反應理論（IRT），來估計模型能力、排名系統、選擇有資訊的範例以及診斷基準質量。<lb/>然而，AI 基準數據常常偏離人類測試的數據範疇，而標準 IRT 估計工具最初是為此開發的：基準通常涉及較少的評估模型、更多的項目，並且能力分佈可能是偏斜的、聚類的或多模態的。<lb/>我們檢視這些範疇不匹配如何挑戰 IRT 建模在 AI 評估中的可靠性。<lb/>使用從六個廣泛使用的 LLM 基準中衍生的項目參數和能力分佈，我們在三個常見的 IRT 模型下模擬反應矩陣，並比較最近基準研究中使用的四種估計工具：邊際最大似然、馬可夫鏈蒙特卡羅、變分推斷和神經偽西亞米斯估計器。<lb/>在 18,000 個模擬條件下，我們系統地評估計算可行性、可擴展性，以及 IRT 對模型排名、預測性能和項目特徵的推斷的可靠性。<lb/>結果顯示，經典估計器在大型基準設置中可能變得不可行，而可擴展估計器在小型或非正態分佈的模型集上可能產生不可靠的項目級和排名推斷。<lb/>本研究確定了潛在特徵模型何時可靠地支持或有風險扭曲 AI 基準聲明，以及需要什麼樣的樣本大小和診斷以確保可信的使用。
